{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for missing or corrupted values
print("Missing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

print("\nUnique values in channel:")
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print("\nUnique values in customer_segment:")
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

print("\nValue counts for converted:")
print(sales_df['converted'].value_counts())

print("\nValue counts for status:")
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (sales_df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print(f"\nNumber of refunded orders: {refunded_count}")

# Confirm that 'converted' is 1 only for completed orders
converted_not_completed = (sales_df['converted'] == 1) & (sales_df['status'] != 'completed')
print(f"Orders with converted=1 but status != completed: {converted_not_completed.sum()}")"}
